title: A Mountain Adventure
text:
Last summer, Maria went on a trip to the mountains. She wanted an adventure, so she took a long hike with her friend Tom. The path was steep, but the view from the top was beautiful. They saw a big lake and many birds.

On the second day, the weather changed. It started to rain, so they put on their red jackets and walked slowly down the hill. In the evening, they found a small house and had a warm dinner. Maria said it was the best trip of her life.

questions.text: Where did Maria go last summer?
How did Maria probably feel about the trip at the end?
Why did Maria and Tom walk slowly down the hill on the second day?
options: They were looking for a house to buy
They wanted to see the lake again
It was raining and they wanted to be safe
They were tired of the birds

vocabulary.definition: an exciting experience, often with some risk
going up or down very quickly, at a high angle
everything you can see from a particular place

paragraph_translations: Latem Maria pojechała w góry. Chciała przygody, więc poszła na długą wędrówkę ze swoją przyjaciółką Tomem. Ścieżka była stroma, ale widok z góry był piękny. Zobaczyli duże jezioro i wiele ptaków.

Drugiego dnia pogoda się zmieniła. Zaczął padać deszcz, więc założyli czerwone kurtki i powoli zeszli z góry. Wieczorem znaleźli mały domek i zjedli ciepłą kolację. Maria powiedziała, że to była najlepsza podróż w jej życiu.
